context: Keep EU customers' repos in the EU

checklist.name: explicit_namespace
checklist.description: Creates a separate namespace with jurisdiction `eu` explicitly through the REST API before any repo is created in it, rather than relying on implicit namespace creation.

checklist.name: immutable_warning
checklist.description: States that a namespace's jurisdiction cannot be changed later, so an existing namespace cannot be moved to the EU.

checklist.name: second_binding
checklist.description: Adds a second Artifacts binding for the EU namespace and picks the binding by region in code.

checklist.name: token_handling
checklist.description: Does not log or return the token from `create()` to an untrusted caller.
